tables.name: member_google_account_choices
tables.owner_query: SELECT c.rowid AS rid, o.account_id, o.tenant_id FROM member_google_account_choices c JOIN member_google_oauth o ON o.state_hash=c.state_hash
tables.key_transition: Expire this account choice with its parent OAuth request. Require fresh member consent after migration or session invalidation.
tables.verification: Resolve exactly one owner through the OAuth state hash and verify the declared foreign key and schema.
tables.on_failure: Quarantine the incomplete authorization and require a new consent in the member session.
